data.title: Senior Manager, Trust Risk 102657
data.description:
Job Requisition ID # 26WD100179 Position Overview The Trust Risk Manager leads the Trust Risk Program at Autodesk and manages a multidisciplinary organization that includes Third-Party Risk Management as well as senior risk professionals. Trust Risk at Autodesk is an established team and program. We are looking for a leader with the lived experience of operationalizing a risk program that is Trusted by leaders and executives to drive risk-based decisions in the areas of Trust - Security, Privacy, Trusted AI, and Resilience. This individual will report directly to the Director of Trust Governance, Risk, and Compliance. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in at least one Trust risk domain and sufficient breadth across security, privacy, trusted AI, resilience, and third-party risk to integrate specialist perspectives into an enterprise risk view. Operationalizing risk management and working with executive stakeholders is as much of an art as it is science. The Trust Risk Manager needs to have lived, practical experience to guide incremental program improvements and help modernize the program in the time of AI. They should be passionate about helping leaders and teams identify and achieve successful outcomes to reduce risk vs checking boxes for short-term gains. The role requires a strategic thinker with a technical background who can work cross-functionally to ensure our products and operations meet the highest standards of security and user trust. This role can be on-site, hybrid, or remote in the US. Responsibilities - Utilize extensive technical risk expertise to help Autodesk maintain and grow its Trust Risk Program. Guide product and engineering teams in proactive planning for managing risk through its entire lifecycle - Develop Trust Risk Program strategy and associated roadmaps, capability monitoring, and operation metrics to focus on impact on Autodesk's overall business goals and Trust standards - Define and execute an AI-enabled modernization strategy for Trust Risk operations. Identify, test, and scale uses of AI and automation that improve risk insight, decision speed, program quality, and analyst capacity while maintaining appropriate human judgment, validation, and governance - Engage with Trust, engineering, product, industry strategy, and program managers to prioritize risk mitigation work while balancing Trust needs with overall Autodesk strategy (prioritization and delivery) - Work with the Trust, Product, and Engineering leadership to establish clear mitigation delivery plans. Create alignment on cross organization initiatives through outcome driven planning, dependency management, and impediment removal. Establish enterprise mechanisms for mitigation accountability, including clear ownership, risk-based prioritization, aging and escalation criteria, executive visibility, and intervention when commitments are stalled or business conditions change - Develop holistic communications plans for delivering status communications and updates in a scalable way that minimizes friction. Support the communication of program health, mitigation work, and achievements to Autodesk teams and divisional leadership - Facilitate fact-based, data-driven decision-making with the appropriate domain expertise and program owners - Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and identify program improvement areas. Bring results to program leaders in an actionable manner - Develop annual and multi-year operating plans for the Trust Risk function, including capability priorities, organizational design, talent requirements, technology investments, budget tradeoffs, and measures of effectiveness Minimum Qualifications - 7+ years of demonstrated experience building, operating, scaling, and materially improving a technical risk management program in a complex technology organization - 4+ years of experience managing people in a remote or hybrid environment - Strong understanding of one or more Trust (security, privacy, resilience, responsible AI) principles - Demonstrated experimentation with or implementation of AI-enabled risk, compliance, security, audit, or operational workflows. Able to distinguish high-value applications from superficial automation and establish appropriate human review, data handling, validation, and measurement practices - Moderate understanding of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2 and ISO 27001) and audit activities - Basic understanding of cloud hosting, infrastructure technologies, SaaS, and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Microsoft) - Experience managing different company stakeholders, from technical teams to business leaders, product managers, and designers - Demonstrated superior communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders. Experience briefing executives and various levels of leaders - Proven record of leading multi-year risk or governance programs that produced measurable improvements in business decision-making, risk reduction, accountability, operational effectiveness, and customer trust - Demonstrated experience communicating and reporting program health, driving initiatives and facilitating the delivery of on-time results Preferred Qualifications - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - Ability to think strategically and execute methodically - Familiarity with regulatory requirements and standards related to security use cases - Experience using tooling to scale programs and solutions (e.g., Jira, Atlassian, SharePoint, various GRC platforms, etc.) - Experience in the software or technology industry - Experience working with cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment - Knowledge of cloud security, data privacy, and threat detection/prevention technologies Learn More About Autodesk Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software - from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk - it's at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you're an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! Benefits From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting https://benefits.autodesk.com/ Salary transparency Salary is one part of Autodesk's competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $152,000 and $272,250. Offers are based on the candidate's experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. Equal Employment Opportunity At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. data.title: Senior Frontend Developer
data.description:
Description MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality. As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release. ﻿Why this role: - Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how. - Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond). - Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard. Responsibilities - Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release. - Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap. - Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine. - Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements. - Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself. - Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community. ﻿This role is not for you if: - You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch. - You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you - You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done. Requirements - 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred). - Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked. - Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution. - Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework. - Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase. - Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows. - Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought. - Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively. - Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option. - Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian. - Full overlap with CET working hours. Would be a plus: - Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features. - Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes. - Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates). What we offer - High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space. - Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package. - Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model. - Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation. - Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply. - Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days. - Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events. ﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together. ﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

At Louco, we’re reinventing how people find and experience events. Finding the right events today is still too difficult, fragmented, and outdated. We’re building a new platform that helps people discover events they actually care about — faster, smarter, and more personalized. From concerts and business events to nightlife, exhibitions, pop-ups, and local experiences — Louco brings everything happening in a city into one modern discovery platform. We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our small, fast-moving team and help build the future of event discovery. You’ll work across frontend and backend systems building features like personalized feeds, recommendations, notifications, venue discovery, ticket integrations, and real-time event experiences. We’re looking for someone who enjoys building products end-to-end, moves fast, and is excited to help shape a product from an early stage. Tasks What You’ll Do - Build and scale full stack systems powering Louco’s event discovery platform — from backend infrastructure and APIs to intuitive frontend user experiences. - Own end-to-end user flows across the platform, ensuring users can seamlessly discover, explore, and attend events. - Develop and improve systems for personalized feeds, recommendations, venue discovery, notifications, search, and ticket integrations across multiple providers. - Help integrate AI into the product experience to improve discovery, personalization, recommendations, and content understanding. - Build scalable ticketing and checkout-related systems connecting users with events in the fastest and simplest way possible. - Collaborate closely with engineers, product, and design to turn ideas into fast, intuitive, and scalable product experiences. - Take ownership of features from idea to production — including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and performance optimization. - Improve platform scalability, reliability, and app performance as Louco continues to grow. - Work in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities evolve quickly and new challenges constantly emerge. - Help shape the future of how people discover and experience real-world events. Requirements Who You Are - You’re a strong full stack engineer who enjoys building scalable product experiences across frontend and backend systems. - You’re highly proficient with technologies in PHP/Laravel, React, Node.js, and TypeScript. - You actively use AI development tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar tools to move faster and work smarter. - You enjoy building end-to-end user experiences and can move seamlessly across product, backend, infrastructure, and integrations. - You move fast, stay calm under pressure, and are able to make smart and pragmatic decisions in fast-changing environments. - You care about clean architecture, scalability, performance, and building products with real user impact. - You take ownership, think independently, and enjoy solving difficult problems with limited resources. - You’re excited about helping reinvent how people discover and experience real-world events. Benefits - Performance-based bonuses for outstanding contributions - High ownership and real product impact - Work directly with the founders - Build the future of event discovery - Flexible remote work - Opportunity to grow with the company long term - Work with modern AI tools and workflows

data.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
data.description:
About Lydian Energy Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America. Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028. Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing. Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings. Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes. Job Scope The Senior Electrical Engineer will provide technical leadership across the development and pre-construction phases of utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects throughout the United States. This is a multi-faceted role suited for an engineer with experience managing concurrent projects across multiple phases of the project lifecycle. The Senior Electrical Engineer will serve as the primary technical resource on assigned projects from early-stage development through construction readiness, coordinating across internal teams and external partners to advance projects on schedule and within scope. Core functions include project-level technical diligence, design optimization, development engineering, pre-construction support, and risk analysis. Responsibilities - Develop and optimize PV / BESS layouts in accordance with land characteristics, permitting constraints, and optimizing for energy harvest, constructability and price efficiency, and long-term operation. Experience creating utility scale PV / BESS layouts and preliminary plan sets in AutoCAD a plus. - Perform energy modeling studies using tools such as PVsyst to ensure production targets are optimized and meet financial goals. - Provide support and management of technical aspects of the project development process, including permitting, interconnection, communications, environmental, topographical, geotechnical, etc. - Oversee design reviews of EPC drawings as Owner and ensure the delivery of the PV system meets prudent industry standards and commercial targets are aligned with the goals of the investment. - Maintain an organized and clearly documented set of project specific technical deliverables. - Interface with the projects’ independent engineer to ensure reports are accurately created and protect both the interests of development and long-term ownership. - Provide construction RFI support as the owner’s engineer. - Provide technical leadership in conjunction with the team to support key stakeholders’ interests. - Conduct site visits and inspections prior to or in support of project completion. - Source and manage external consultants and partners, including developing Scope of Work documents, managing RFP process, and controlling scope and schedule to obtain similar deliverables. - Own all electrical deliverables assigned from development through pre-construction - Ensure design maturity of PV/BESS and completeness before EPC award - Lead PV and BESS system design, including layouts, DC/AC sizing, and configuration - Optimize for energy yield, cost, and constructability - Own production modeling and align assumptions with financial models - Ensure consistency between technical design and investment case - Define complete and unambiguous Owner’s requirements for EPC contracts - Eliminate design ambiguity and reduce redesign risk post-NTP - Manage and hold consultants accountable for scope, schedule, and quality - Coordinate with permitting, interconnection, environmental, and independent engineers Qualifications - data.title: Senior Backend (Product) Engineer
data.description:
About ev.energy We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP). By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels. We are scaling rapidly across North America and Europe. We are moving fast, we are AI-first, and we are looking for builders who want to power the grid of the future. About the role Our core platform is built in Python and Django, so we're looking for experienced backend software engineers with strong Python skills; Django experience would be beneficial but we’re open to other frameworks. You'll be the person who takes a product idea and builds the systems, services, and infrastructure that make it real — reliable, scalable, and fast to iterate on. We're not looking for generalists who dabble across the stack — we're looking for someone with deep backend craft who can move fast, build with AI as a core part of how they work, and take genuine ownership of what they ship. We're hiring for a number of roles across both of our Technology teams: new product development and customer delivery. We'd love to talk to you about both teams, understand what excites you, and place you into the team where we think you'll thrive best.What you’ll do Backend engineering and architecture - Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that power our product — from data models to infrastructure to production reliability - Make sound architectural decisions that balance shipping speed against long-term maintainability and scale - Take ownership of significant technical areas — from identifying the right approach to shipping and iterating in production Building and shipping with AI - Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a core, daily part of how you write and ship code — not an occasional add-on - Build working backend prototypes fast — good enough to validate with real usage, not over-engineered before it's proven - Know when a rough implementation is right for the moment and when production-grade engineering is needed — and apply that judgment confidently - Ship, measure, learn, iterate — kill what isn't working, double down on what is Product and stakeholder collaboration - Work closely with product, design, and commercial stakeholders to translate customer problems into technical solutions - Act as a credible engineering voice in cross-functional discussions, pilot programmes, and technical scoping conversations - Partner with Customer Support, Program Management, and Demand Generation to understand how customers find, adopt, and stay with ev.energy Raising the bar - Share what you learn openly, challenge how things are built, and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you - Model what AI-native backend engineering looks like in practice — not in theory - Contribute to a culture of experimentation, velocity, and commercial impact Our tech stack - Python and Django for our core platform - Django REST Framework for our APIs - React, React Native and TypeScript for our web and mobile app - PostgreSQL, Redis and DynamoDB for data storage - AWS for hosting, with infrastructure managed as code using Terraform - Claude (via the Anthropic API) features to power AI What we're looking for Must-haves - Strong Python experience (5+ years), with a clear track record of building and shipping production backend systems - Experience building backend services with a Python framework (e.g Django, FastAPI or Flask) - Strong experience building with AI — you've taken AI-powered features or products from concept through to production, and use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a genuine daily practice, not just occasionally - Solid understanding of backend fundamentals — APIs, data modelling, databases, system design, and production reliability - Experience leading technical decisions and influencing direction without relying on hierarchy - Strong communication skills — written, verbal, and technical — credible with engineers, product, and commercial stakeholders - High bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — you make good technical decisions with incomplete information Nice to haves - Experience in energy, utilities, cleantech, or adjacent domains - Experience with Django - Familiarity with EV fleet operations, home energy management, or grid services - Front-end or full-stack capability that lets you prototype independently without blocking on others - A portfolio of backend systems, tools, or products that prove how you work - Direct customer conversation experience that's shaped what you've built Salary, benefits & how we work The salary range for this role is £69,300-£84,900 GBP. Key benefits include: - Equity - you'll own a part of the business through our share options program - Healthcare options - to help keep you and your family in tip-top condition (provided by Bupa & Medicash) - Life assurance of 3x your salary - Co-working access via WeWork (if you'd like it) - Annual 'Team Week' whole company offsite - L&D allowance of £1,000 per year - everyone is learning, developing and challenging themselves so we have a professional development fund per year for you to learn new skills You can find out more about our full range of perks and benefits here. Location & how we work This role is fully remote in the UK. The majority of people at ev.energy work on a fully remote basis, with a small number of roles based on-site in our testing sites. This means that most of our people work from home, but we're happy to provide co-working subscriptions if you'd like to spend time at a WeWork (or other co-working space close to you). We balance our remote set up by getting everyone together once a year for an offsite, as we know that spending time together IRL is super important. Belonging at ev.energy We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity: we do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. data.title: Head of Simulation Engineering (Expression of Interest)
data.description:
Expression of Interest · Inquire First We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest. Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment. Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership Turn simulation research into an experimental engine that can be inspected, reproduced, and improved. Lead the engineering function at the boundary between scientific methods and dependable software. Why Subconscious Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need. The function you will build Own simulation implementation, experiment execution semantics, reproducibility standards, and the simulation engineering hiring plan. Partner with causal research on method design, evaluation on quality, and infrastructure on reliable operation. This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed. Proposed first 90 days after joining Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start. - Trace an experiment from configuration to output and document which inputs, model versions, random states, and artifacts are required to reproduce it. - Establish an implementation contract for treatments, populations, execution, and result aggregation, with meaningful correctness checks. - Profile a representative workload and improve its largest quality, throughput, or cost constraint without silently changing the experimental question. - Build a research-to-production path with versioned interfaces, reviewable changes, and explicit failure handling. How we will judge progress Research ideas become reusable capabilities with explainable behavior. Track reproducibility, correctness under independently specified test cases, experiment throughput, and cost. Make changes in model behavior distinguishable from execution defects. What you bring - You have led research engineering, simulation, scientific computing, or ML systems work and shipped robust implementations of complex methods. - You can reason about stochastic systems, numerical behavior, experiment design, and performance while writing and reviewing production code. - You can lead a technical roadmap across researchers and engineers and make explicit tradeoffs between exploration and stability. We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence. Compensation and funding We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed. Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant. How we work Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed. Expect direct collaboration with the founders, work across scientific and commercial boundaries, and responsibility for doing the early work yourself. The current role does not include visa sponsorship. Confirm practical collaboration hours and any travel expectations during the initial conversation. Start with work you already own Describe a research method you brought into production. What could go wrong in the translation, how did you test correctness, and what did you change after real use? Please do not share confidential employer or customer materials. Bring your questions about our product, evidence, team, finances, and the authority attached to the role. Mutual diligence matters for a decision of this size.

Join the Sleep Fitness Movement At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. We are seeking someone who is passionate about designing, implementing, and supporting distributed systems and appreciates the impact they have on all aspects of the member experience. Innovation in a culture of excellence Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness. Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards. Collaboration with exceptional talent Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment. Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. Your own Pod - and other great benefits - Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod, along with*: - Full access to health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents - Supplemental life insurance - Flexible PTO - Commuter benefits to ease your daily commute - Paid parental leave *List of benefits may vary depending on your location At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Please note: This role is open to applicants in the US and Canada. The compensation listed is reflective of candidates based in California and New York.

data.title: Director of Software Engineering, Platform Services
data.description:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! The Director of Software Engineering, Platform Services will help to modernize the engineering organization at Credit Acceptance by building and leading teams that deliver two sets of capabilities: the tooling, templates and standards that engineers use to build software, and the shared engineering services that multiple parts of the organization depend on, including internal products such as payments, notifications, consent and document intelligence. This role will be responsible for consolidating services that are used by multiple parts of the organization into a single place, eliminating duplication and modernizing the technology. Credit Acceptance is adopting AI-assisted and specification-driven development across its engineering organization, and this role will lead that work. It includes the software development lifecycle and the tooling that supports it, the development environments engineers work in, the AI coding assistants and agent development frameworks they use, the golden path templates and reference implementations that make recommended practices the default, and the measurement of whether these investments are improving engineering productivity. The ideal candidate is someone who can build and lead a platform engineering team to create the foundational tooling and services for Credit Acceptance’s scaling while also creating process and structure for the company’s growth. They should create a team culture of amplifying scale and creating strong advocates within the product verticals. They should have experience leading a high-performance horizontal engineering team, identifying what the company needs and achieving outcomes that push the company forward and accelerate engineering velocity and productivity. Equally important is a track record of delivering internal developer tooling and shared services as products, with the adoption and operational ownership that comes with them.Outcomes and Activities: - This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member. - Provide the strategy, leadership and day-to-day management of the Platform Services organization. - Lead the team in developing, enhancing, and supporting a set of integrated platform services for Credit Acceptance engineering teams to leverage in releasing high quality software to its customers. - Define the company’s approach to AI-assisted and specification-driven development, including coding assistants, agent development frameworks, and the standards and guardrails required to release their output safely. - Deliver the golden path templates, scaffolds and reference implementations that engineering teams use to start new work, including the frameworks and patterns those templates establish. - Own the development environments and inner loop tooling engineers use daily, including build and test performance and environment provisioning. - Be accountable for the availability, performance and support model of the shared services the organization operates, including service level objectives and on-call coverage for those services. - Create and manage the Platform Services experience required to quickly, reliably, efficiently, and securely deliver value to developers, and grow adoption across the product verticals so that the supported path is the default path. - Partner with the teams that operate delivery pipelines, cloud infrastructure and runtime platforms to deliver and support the capabilities this organization builds. - Establish and report the measures of engineering productivity, platform adoption and service performance, along with the progress of the organization’s projects. - Refine and deliver on a strategy that aligns platform goals to business objectives, priorities, and budgetary realities, weighing build, buy and open source options against the company’s ability to operate what is selected. - Ensure Credit Acceptance’s engineering tooling and shared services meet the company’s security, privacy and audit requirements and align with corporate goals. - Support business growth initiatives from a Platform Services point of view by aligning the technology vision with business strategy. - Build and manage diverse engineering teams capable of carrying out ambitious platform software initiatives, recruiting and developing engineering leaders and top engineering talent in the Platform Services space. - Set the direction of the team; anticipate strategic and scaling-related challenges via thoughtful planning, both from a personnel and technical standpoint, and lead organizational change in alignment with the company’s objectives. - Break down platform strategy and team asks into correct technical building blocks, mentoring the team’s technical output and keeping skills and knowledge current. - Provide continuous feedback, address underperformance, and recognize the individual strengths and contributions of team members. - Drive a results-oriented culture with a strong focus on execution, quality, and speed, and keep the quality bar high for the services other teams depend on. Competencies: The following items detail how you will be successful in this role. - Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience. - Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions. - One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively. - Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business. Requirements: - BS/MS in Computer Science, engineering/technical degree, MBA preferred - 10+ years of experience in highly technical roles in development or enterprise services, at large organizations or innovative startups - 5+ years of supervisory, consultant or team lead experience, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple teams. - Track record of delivering internal developer tooling, developer platforms or shared engineering services that were adopted by other engineering teams. - Experience leading the adoption of AI-assisted software development at scale, including coding assistants, agentic development workflows, evaluation, and the guardrails required to release generated code. - History of owning services in production, including service level objectives, on-call rotations and incident response. - Proven ability to consolidate duplicated capabilities into a single supported platform, including the migration and decommissioning work required. - Demonstrated ability to communicate with C-Level leaders, conveying complex information in a timely and easily understood way to all levels of the organization. Preferred: - Familiarity with agent development frameworks, model access layers or other AI platform capabilities - Background in a regulated industry, or working closely with security, audit and compliance functions - Working knowledge of the financial services industry, loan origination systems, web-based applications, and the automotive industry Knowledge and Skills: - Working knowledge of the modern developer toolchain, including source control and code review workflows, continuous integration, containers, infrastructure as code, and developer portal or service catalog products. - Proven ability to think strategically, align technical initiatives with business objectives, and formulate a team’s technical strategy and roadmap in partnership with other teams. - Success growing a team and fostering a collaborative, ambitious, and outcome-driven culture that embodies company values. - Comfortable with navigating hard-to-follow (or non-existent) processes and comfortable identifying processes which aren’t working and changing them. - History of using data for decision making and providing a strong technical vision that your teams deliver against consistently. - An automation mindset that strives to reduce manual interventions wherever relevant. - Strong executive presence and ability to advance ideas and initiatives, keeping the customer and the company’s best interest in mind. Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $208,761 – $306,182. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity, between 20 - 60%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego. ## Indenglp #zip Benefits - Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work Our Company Values: To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: - Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions - Respectful by collaborating and actively listening - Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions - Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage - Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting To create an environment where people do their best work, we focus on the dimensions of Organizational Health. Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

The Services Architect is an advanced individual contributor within the Services Architecture team, contributing to the technical direction, quality, and delivery of content across the Professional Services Portfolio. Operating with a high degree of autonomy while aligning with the overarching portfolio strategy, this role leads the design and execution of net-new consulting service offerings, courses, and enablement programs, and helps establish standards for the broader team. In this position, the architect provides technical guidance across team projects, handles content and offering escalations, and actively mentors Associate Services Architects. Working in close collaboration with portfolio leadership, the role supports offering strategy and product roadmap alignment, while periodically teaching customer classes or delivering service engagements to ensure content remains grounded in real-world customer experience.

Your Opportunity:

Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Portfolio Direction: Shape the Professional Services Portfolio by identifying gaps and opportunities and proposing and prioritizing new offerings aligned with corporate strategy and product roadmaps.
  • Offering Ownership: Design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, enablement content, educational material, and technical presentations for webinars and events, and lead development of the most complex and strategic net-new offerings.
  • Standards & Quality: Maintain high technical, content, and lab quality standards across the portfolio, ensuring that project outputs and contributions, including work from Associate Services Architects, consistently adhere to established team standards and templates.
  • Roadmap Alignment: Stay informed about Tenable product changes, evaluate requirements for offering updates, and plan portfolio updates well ahead of product release.
  • Advisory: Advise the Senior Director, Services Portfolio, on offering strategy, resourcing, and delivery risk.

Content Development & Delivery

  • Requirements Review: Review user and technical requirements for completeness and clarity.
  • Collateral: Create collateral for new offerings and evaluate existing offerings and content for accuracy and relevance.
  • Pre-Production Training: Deliver pre-production training sessions to evaluate product suitability and gather early feedback.
  • Live Demonstrations: Create live demonstration recordings for the Tenable product suite.
  • Content Review: Perform content reviews with peers in Services, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Management to ensure quality and alignment with customer needs, and act as the final technical approver for release.
  • Customer Experience: Periodically teach customer classes or deliver service engagements to obtain intimate knowledge of the customer experience.

Strategic Engagement & Support

  • Field Perspective: Collaborate with Professional Services peers to understand the field perspective on service and training offering requirements.
  • Customer & Partner Engagement: Engage with customers and partners to analyze market trends and the competitive landscape, and translate findings into portfolio decisions.
  • Problem Solving: Provide solutions to a wide range of difficult problems while maintaining a positive attitude and positive working relationships, gathering information to support data-driven decisions.
  • Escalation Support: Act as the final escalation point for Customer Care, Services, and Product escalations relating to portfolio content that the Associate Services Architect cannot resolve.
  • Staying Current: Remain abreast of corporate direction and strategy, product roadmaps, messaging, and emerging trends in the security industry.

Project, People & Process

  • Delivery Oversight: Independently manage assigned projects and provide delivery oversight of team members’ projects to ensure delivery on schedule and on budget.
  • Mentoring: Mentor and develop Associate Services Architect colleagues, including setting expectations for the Associate role’s intake and review.
  • Process Improvement: Remain abreast of educational learning frameworks, content development approaches, and technologies that may reduce cost or shorten development timelines, and drive adoption where they do.
  • Other Duties: May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

What You'll Need:

Experience

  • Security Foundations: 5+ years of overall experience in Information Security.
  • Vulnerability Management & Cybersecurity: 1+ years of experience in vulnerability management and broader cybersecurity operations, ideally utilizing enterprise assessment tools such as the Tenable product suite.
  • Services Experience: 3+ years of professional services, technical support, or sales engineering experience.
  • Curriculum Design: Proven experience designing and delivering technical curricula, training, and customer enablement programs, as well as leading others to do so.

Knowledge and Education

  • Education: B.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Technical Depth: In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems and of TCP/IP networking.
  • Emerging Domains: Working knowledge of web application security, container security, cloud environments (AWS/Azure), and ICS/SCADA systems, with in-depth expertise in at least one.
  • Security Tools: Familiarity with security assessment tools such as Nessus, Kali Linux, and Metasploit.

Other Requirements

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior internal and customer audiences.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including at a senior level.
  • Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both in a self-directed manner and as part of a geographically distributed team, setting direction for others without day-to-day supervision.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full time remote role for candidates in the US (EST), UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The Opportunity:

The Grafana IRM squad operates a business critical set of services that help Grafana and multiple organizations across the globe respond to incidents. Our mission is “We make it easy to detect, respond, and learn from incidents with minimal toil”. We have three functional squads within our team, frontend, backend and mobile, but our work is usually spread across the three functions.

Our domain is quite large and it is constantly evolving. Our key values are unified experience, automation and integration and Observability Native. We are customer focused and aim to provide an excellent customer experience for efficient usage with a high degree of automation and integration to multiple 3rd party systems that our users can leverage. When we say Observability Native is in our core, we really mean it, we want to highlight the integration of IRM with observability, which enables teams to gain actionable insights and resolve incidents more efficiently. The value is faster and more informed decision making.

Grafana IRM is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives.
  • Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.
  • Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers.
  • Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope.
  • Design, build, operate, and maintain Grafana’s mobile Application, owning the reliability, performance, and availability.
  • Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the application you’re running.
  • Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team.
  • Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action.
  • You are customer focused.
  • We build everything with our users in mind.

data.title: Staff AI Engineer (Data & Intelligence function)
data.description:
About Acquia Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out. Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it! Career Exploration at Acquia Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary. Acquia is the digital experience platform built for a world where your audience isn't only human. Its agents too. As AI agents become active participants in how people discover, consume, and act on digital content, Acquia gives enterprise teams the platform to create, manage, and distribute experiences designed for both. Powered by agentic AI that orchestrates — not just advises — Acquia automates complex digital workflows within the governance guardrails large organizations require. The world's #1 Drupal hosting provider, Acquia brings together Content Management, Digital Asset Management, and Product Information Management in a single AI-powered Command Center: Acquia Source. Acquia. Built for every audience, human or otherwise. The Role: Acquia is seeking a Staff AI Engineer to join our Data & Intelligence function. Acquia runs one of the largest Drupal and digital experience footprints in the world, and holds more than a decade of operational, product, and customer data across it. This role exists to put that data to work: building the retrieval, graph, and inference layers on top of our data platform, and the agentic and deterministic systems that turn the resulting signals into action for our customers and our teams. The remit is broad. Our function spans observability, our core data platform, and insights and intelligence, and you will work across all three alongside the product and platform teams that consume what we build. Scope moves with company priorities, so we are looking for someone comfortable changing context and picking up an unfamiliar problem. Much of what you build will be shared capability that several teams depend on. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend most of your time designing, building, and shipping production systems, and you will lift the AI engineering capability of the teams around you through the quality of your work rather than through management overhead. We ship early and iterate. Key Responsibilities - Write and ship production AI code daily. You are an active contributor. - Lead our work on making customer context retrievable at speed, across semantic retrieval, indexing, and knowledge graph approaches over our data platform. An early priority is letting an agent resolve a customer and pull its full context in a single request. Where that work goes from there is partly yours to define. - Build the inference and signal layer: models and processors that read from our Iceberg-based lakehouse, write scored inference back, and expose signals through contracts other teams can build against. - Take signals through to action, turning detected conditions such as churn risk, usage and entitlement mismatch, or expansion opportunity into workflows that act, with human review where that is the right design. - Choose the right tool for each workload: a large model, a small fine-tuned model, or ordinary deterministic code. Managing inference cost is part of the job. - Own evaluation and observability for our AI systems, so we can show a signal is sound before anyone acts on it. - Set the patterns other teams build against, and work with engineering and business leaders to turn company goals into shipped systems. How We Think About Experience We are more interested in how you learn than in the tools already on your CV. Our stack spans Python, SQL and dbt, distributed query engines, durable workflow orchestration, an Iceberg lakehouse on S3, and a changing mix of model providers and agent frameworks. It will look different in a year. We expect you to arrive without deep expertise in some of it and to close that gap fast, using AI to read unfamiliar codebases and get to a useful contribution before you are fully fluent. Range across languages, data platforms, and model providers counts for more with us than years inside any single one. Required Experience - 8+ years of software engineering, including 3+ years shipping AI or ML systems to production. - Strong programming fundamentals and deep proficiency in at least one language used for AI and data work. Python is our primary language for ML and insights. - Fluency working with data at scale — advanced SQL, a transformation layer such as dbt, and a distributed query engine over lakehouse or warehouse storage, including reasoning about query cost and partitioning. - Production retrieval and context engineering — embeddings, vector search, hybrid or graph retrieval, and measuring whether retrieval is actually working. Experience modelling entities and relationships across multi-source data is valuable here. - Agentic systems and durable workflows in production, with tool calling, state and memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns. We use Temporal and LangGraph; equivalent experience transfers. - Evaluation and observability for AI systems — tracing, prompt and version management, and dataset-driven testing, whatever the tooling. - Cloud deployment experience (AWS preferred) with containerized services, and ownership of inference cost. - B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Desired Skills - Experience standing up shared data or ML capability that other teams then built on. - Small and fine-tuned model work, including distilling task-specific models to replace general-model calls at scale. - Observability data fluency: OpenTelemetry, and logs, metrics and traces at very high volume, including what it takes to make that data queryable. - Data governance instincts around access control, lineage, and data residency, treated as part of the design. - Enterprise SaaS or CMS, including familiarity with Acquia's Drupal-based DXP. - Agentic development workflow fluency: AI-assisted coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as everyday accelerators, and MCP or similar for connecting agents to real systems. - Strong communication skills — able to present AI system design to both engineers and C-suite stakeholders. - Senior IC track record — known for the quality of your own code and system designs, with mentoring that happens organically through great work, not through meetings. We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals. Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more! Acquia is an equal opportunity (EEO) employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veterans status or any other protected status or characteristic under federal, state or local law unrelated to the ability to perform the job. We are seeking an AI-Native candidate who treats AI not as an external tool, but as a fundamental extension of their cognitive workflow. The ideal candidate possesses an orchestration mindset—the ability to skillfully prompt, manage, and direct AI to navigate complexity—and maintains a high degree of AI fluency. You should be characterized by radical adaptability and a “builder” mentality, showing a restless drive to transform traditional work processes into agentic workflows. Beyond technical proficiency, we value intellectual humility: the willingness to constantly unlearn old methods in favor of more efficient, AI-augmented processes. You don't just use AI to do your job; you use it to redefine what your job can achieve. Pay Range $150,000—$200,000 USD

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/staff-ai-engineer-data-intelligence-function-acquia-inc

Our mission is “We make it easy to detect, respond, and learn from incidents with minimal toil”. When we say Observability Native is in our core, we really mean it, we want to highlight the integration of IRM with observability, which enables teams to gain actionable insights and resolve incidents more efficiently. The value is faster and more informed decision making.

  • You are customer focused.
  • We build everything with our users in mind.
  • You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively.
  • Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Experience with at least one native mobile platform (Android or iOS).
  • Strong experience building production Flutter apps, including state management, navigation, asynchronous programming, and architecting maintainable codebases.
  • Experience taking mobile features from idea to release in a self-driven way, from clarifying requirements and exploring solutions to building, testing, CI/CD workflows, and shipping updates to the App Store and Google Play
  • Comfort integrating mobile apps with backend APIs and cloud services
  • Write clean, maintainable, and performant code that is easy for other engineers to understand and extend.

data.title: Director of Media Strategy & Activation (Paid Media)
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description

Dropbox is looking for a Director of Media to own our total media investment—performance and brand—under a single leader.

This leader will build a unified media strategy that brings performance marketing and brand investments together into one investment thesis and one operating model. They will own the media portfolio end-to-end, from upper-funnel brand campaigns through paid search, paid social, programmatic, mobile, and emerging channels, making investment tradeoffs as business priorities evolve.

The role also owns how the media organization operates, balancing in-house expertise, agency partnerships, and specialist support to maximize speed, quality, and impact.

The ideal candidate has worked on both sides of the industry—building media expertise at an agency before leading media inside a technology or high-growth company. They understand what great agency partnerships look like while also knowing how to build world-class internal capabilities.

This role sits at the center of Dropbox's growth strategy, connecting brand, performance marketing, Product Growth, Sales, and Marketing Data Science to drive measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Unified Media Strategy. Build and own Dropbox's media strategy across brand and performance. Set the annual and quarterly investment thesis, define the channel portfolio, and make the tradeoff decisions on where spend moves and why.

  • Total Budget Ownership. Manage Dropbox's full media investment across paid search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, mobile, affiliate, and brand channels. Own planning, forecasting, pacing, and in-quarter reallocation against efficiency and growth targets.

  • Brand and Performance Integration. Align reach, frequency, creative strategy, and channel mix so brand and performance investment reinforce each other rather than compete. Partner closely with the Brand organization, which owns brand positioning and creative direction, to translate brand strategy into media execution.

  • Operating Model and Partnerships. Design and run the right mix of in-house capability and agency partnership. Own agency relationships, and build the internal muscle where needed.

  • AI-Enabled Media Operations. Develop and execute a point of view on where agentic and AI-enabled workflows belong in the media stack — creative production and testing velocity, audience modeling, budget allocation, bid strategy, reporting, and quality control. Make deliberate decisions about where machine judgment outperforms human judgment, and where it does not.

  • Connect Media to Revenue. Partner with Product Growth, Sales, and Marketing Data Science to connect media signals to downstream outcomes — activation, conversion, product-qualified leads, expansion, and retention. Build the acquisition layer of a unified self-serve and sales-assisted revenue system.

  • Measurement Rigor. Partner with Marketing Data Science on attribution, incrementality testing, and media mix modeling. Be a sophisticated consumer and challenger of measurement methodology, and translate complex performance tradeoffs into crisp, executive-ready recommendations.

  • Team Leadership. Lead and grow a team of channel and brand media leaders. Build clarity on what each person owns, how they are measured, and how their work ladders to revenue.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in media, performance marketing, or digital marketing with increasing scope and leadership responsibility, at a high-growth B2B and/or B2C company
  • 4+ years leading teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and org design
  • Deep, hands-on expertise across paid channels — search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, mobile — including planning, forecasting, budget pacing, audience design, and performance management
  • Experience owning brand media alongside performance media, with working knowledge of brand lift measurement, reach and frequency planning, and creative performance optimization
  • Track record managing significant media budgets with clear, demonstrated impact on acquisition efficiency, pipeline, or revenue
  • Experience managing agency and vendor ecosystems — scoping, selecting, and holding partners accountable — and building in-house capability where it creates advantage
  • Strong analytical fluency: attribution approaches, incrementality testing, MMM/MTA concepts, and unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback)
  • Experience marketing across self-serve, product-led, and sales-assisted motions, and adapting programs across consumer, SMB, and mid-market segments
  • Excellent executive communication: you can turn a complicated performance picture into a clear recommendation and defend it

Preferred Qualifications

  • Agency and in-house background. You built your craft agency-side and then brought that capability in-house at a technology or high-growth company. You have operated on both sides of the partnership.

  • AI and agentic media workflows. Demonstrated use of AI-enabled workflows in a media context — creative generation and testing, audience modeling, automated reporting, budget or bid optimization — with a clear view of where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk. Candidates with less conventional experience will be strongly considered if they spike here.

  • Experience building a media strategy or media planning function

  • Familiarity with modern martech and adtech stacks: CDPs, marketing automation, attribution platforms, tagging and data governance

  • Experience navigating measurement disruption — privacy changes, cookie deprecation, first-party data strategy

  • Multi-product portfolio experience, including cross-sell and attach motions

  • International or EMEA media experience

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

US Zone 1

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2
$205,800—$278,400 USD
US Zone 3
$182,900—$247,500 USD
