data.title: Senior Director, Field Enablement
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - San Francisco, CA)

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

ABOUT THE ROLE

PagerDuty is seeking a Sr. Director, Field Enablement to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Sr. Director of Field Enablement, you will lead a team of enablement professionals supporting our sales, customer success, and partnership organizations.

You will build and scale our global enablement function to ensure our customer-facing teams are equipped to sell and support our diversifying product portfolio as we enter our next phase of growth. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the enablement strategy for a high-growth SaaS company and directly improve teams' capabilities and productivity worldwide. The ideal candidate is a strategic, seasoned enablement leader passionate about gathering customer feedback and competitive intelligence to develop programs that drive sales excellence and business results.

ABOUT PAGERDUTY

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, execute, optimize, and assess enablement programs in partnership with sales and customer success leadership, determining priorities and success metrics with key stakeholders
  • Gather and share insights from customers, competitors, and the market to enable the positioning of PagerDuty’s value proposition to the market
  • Drive the creation of learning programs and events that align with overall sales and company strategy, enhancing team capabilities, productivity, and high-level selling skills
  • Build and maintain an enablement delivery platform that provides scalable, measurable content and learning resources to sales, customer success, and partnership teams
  • Collaborate with marketing and product marketing to develop highly effective and repeatable sales messaging, selling tools, and collateral that enable consistent execution
  • Design and maintain an end-to-end sales onboarding program in collaboration with HR that certifies new hires on company strategy, product messaging, and sales processes
  • Develop and lead the everboarding process for the sales team to ensure the continued development of required behaviors and skills to successfully operate a consumption driven business
  • Build out and scale enablement support functions for Customer Success and Partnerships organizations
  • Communicate the enablement strategy, roadmap, and KPIs to stakeholders across all global organizations
  • Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement resources, including sales playbooks, battle cards, product collateral, content library, and competitive intelligence
  • Drive adoption and utilization of sales enablement tools such as MindTickle and Highspot
  • Partner with the sales systems team to drive adoption and utilization of sales tools such as Clari, Salesloft, Salesforce, and others
  • Conduct regular assessments and audits of sales processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization.
  • Set key metrics to assess the impact of sales enablement efforts on sales performance
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in sales enablement

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus
  • 10+ years of sales enablement experience or a combination of sales / post sales, sales training, and enablement roles
  • 5+ years of management experience leading and developing enablement teams
  • Proven track record of building and delivering innovative, strategic sales enablement programs, including training, onboarding, certifications, and sales events
  • Experience implementing and maintaining content management platforms such as Highspot or Seismic
  • 3+ years of experience in high-velocity, high-growth startup environments, preferably in the SaaS space, or equivalent degree or experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong understanding of sales methodologies such as Force Management, MEDDIC and forecasting best practices
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively train and influence sales professionals at all levels
  • Experience with Sales Operations and Salesforce.com
  • Proficiency in using sales enablement tools, CRM systems, and content management platforms. Preferred platforms include Salesforce, Seismic, CRM Analytics, and more
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to provide actionable insights
  • Knowledge of Sales Manager training and sales coaching, particularly for Enterprise sales
  • Strong program and project management skills with the ability to maintain calendars of ongoing training, business reviews, and field communications
  • Detail and results-oriented with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution
  • Collaborative and team-oriented approach with the ability to work cross-functionally
  • Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for driving sales excellence
  • Excel in creating and curating sales collateral, playbooks, training modules, and other resources to support the sales team
  • Have a track record of driving sales enablement initiatives across different regions and markets, understanding cultural nuances and local sales practices

The base salary range for this position is 180,000 - 303,600 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*
  • ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*
  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO
  • Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*
  • Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
  • Company-wide hack weeks
  • Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. Headquarters: Remote - US

Backend Engineer

About LaunchDarkly Engineering

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the role

We have multiple backend engineering roles open on various teams. The specific level, scope, and technical focus will be aligned to the opportunity and the candidate’s experience. Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, SDK engineering, data infrastructure, observability, or AI/agent systems may be relevant for some teams.

As a Backend Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will design, build, and operate the services that power reliable software delivery for our customers. You may work on APIs, distributed systems, configuration and event pipelines, data services, SDK-related infrastructure, platform capabilities, or backend systems supporting our product experiences.

You will work with experienced engineers, Product, Design, and partner teams to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to own work from early design through production, learn from real customer impact, and contribute to systems that operate at meaningful scale.

What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, test, and operate production services and APIs.
  • Lead projects or meaningful components of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.
  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.
  • Improve the observability and operability of the systems you own, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and incident learnings.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to understand needs and deliver useful outcomes.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and learning from teammates.
  • Investigate production issues calmly and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements.
  • Contribute to a culture of inclusive collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and API design.
  • Experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language. (Most of our teams use Go)
  • Experience designing or contributing to services that need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable as usage grows.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • A collaborative approach and a sense of ownership for both your work and its downstream customer impact.
  • Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and working through ambiguous problems.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

About Smart Working At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally. Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. About the Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will take ownership of large-scale production backend systems that handle high volumes of data, connected devices, video and location information. This is a full-time, long-term role, with a target start date of November 2026. You will work in a small, experienced team of around 10 in-house developers, where independent thinking and technical decision-making are important. The role is fully backend-focused, covering systems for DVR cameras, event reconstruction, tracking, vehicle telematics, fuel and EV data. As most customers are in the public sector, security, GDPR compliance and video footage retention are key priorities. You will work on existing systems with limited documentation, help modernise the platform and collaborate closely with the developer leading the computer vision work. Responsibilities - Own and evolve the PHP backend that ingests GPS and telematics data, safety hardware events and DVR video, and sends real-time alerts. - Build and maintain APIs used by the web platform, mobile application and integration partners. - Deliver the ongoing Yii2-to-Laravel migration, with Yii2 at end of life and approximately a year remaining to complete the migration. - Deliver the ongoing MariaDB-to-PostgreSQL migration. - Support the decomposition of the existing monolith into microservices. - Take over systems from a retiring contractor and become productive quickly despite limited documentation. - Support the backend for the AI product line, working alongside the developer currently leading computer vision work; the exact scope is still to be confirmed. - Take end-to-end ownership of production systems rather than requiring prior people-management or project-lead experience. - Work independently within a small senior team while collaborating closely on AI-related work. - Apply architectural judgement to microservices and database migrations, with particular attention to data integrity during migration. - Work flexibly within established practices, including Bitbucket Pipelines and PHPUnit, in a small team with light process. - Contribute as a problem-solver, applying senior technical judgement to production engineering decisions. - Work thoroughly on production systems used by local authorities while ramping up quickly for the required start date. Requirements - 8+ years of commercial PHP backend development at Expert level. - 5+ years of experience with large-scale SaaS or complex production systems at Expert level; simple or low-traffic systems will not meet the required standard. - 3+ years of PostgreSQL experience at Advanced level. - 5+ years of API design and third-party integration experience at Advanced level. - 3+ years of high-volume data processing experience at Advanced level, including event-driven systems and ingestion pipelines; IoT or device data ingestion, streaming or queue-based systems are acceptable substitutes. - 3+ years of Laravel and/or Yii2 experience at Advanced level. - 3+ years of PHPUnit experience at Advanced level; other PHP testing frameworks such as Pest or Codeception may substitute. - 2+ years of microservices or monolith-decomposition experience at Intermediate level; service-oriented or modular architecture work may substitute. - 2+ years of AWS experience at Intermediate level; Azure or GCP may substitute. - Experience in the telematics, fleet or logistics domain at Intermediate level; IoT, GPS/location technology or connected-device experience may substitute. - Experience with video, CCTV or large media file handling at Intermediate level; large-file storage, retrieval and retention at scale may substitute. - Ability to take end-to-end ownership of mature production systems, work independently with limited hand-holding and apply strong technical judgement. - Strong complex-system exposure is essential. Experience with complex systems matters more than years alone, and backgrounds limited to simple or basic applications are not suitable. Nice to Have - Experience with MariaDB/MySQL at scale, particularly relevant to an environment currently migrating from MariaDB to PostgreSQL. - Front-end experience, although this is not required for this 100% backend role. - Familiarity with CI/CD using Bitbucket Pipelines; GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins are suitable alternatives. - Familiarity with AI or computer vision, including YOLO-type object detection; ML or image-processing pipeline exposure may substitute. - Experience combining event-driven or IoT-style data ingestion with large media files at scale, ideally alongside an ML pipeline. - AI experience is a tiebreaker only and candidates should not be excluded for lacking it.

You will configure Copilot Studio and agent guardrails, build Purview controls that make Copilot safe to scale, run intake and lifecycle processes, and produce the frameworks and playbooks our clients operate from. You will work alongside a Sr. AI Governance Consultant on larger programs and own workstreams end to end on smaller ones. The right person has implemented governance in real tenants, is starting to design it, and wants to grow into leading engagements. Responsibilities AI & Agent Governance - Implement agent lifecycle governance across Agent Builder, SharePoint agents, Copilot Studio, and Copilot connectors: intake forms and routing, maker access and publishing models, ownership change processes, monitoring, and retirement. - Configure Copilot Studio-specific DLP and connector policy (event triggers, channels, knowledge sources, HTTP requests, Graph and federated connectors) and credit consumption caps. - Support Agent 365 governance: agent inventory, identity, policy, and audit alongside Defender, Purview, and Entra ID. - Build AI CoE operating artifacts: roles and responsibilities, monitoring cadences, Agent Insights reporting, and review and escalation workflows. - Contribute to AI Opportunity Labs: AI solution and agent inventory, risk and security gap analysis, and governance maturity scoring. Power Platform & Platform Governance - Configure environments, environment groups, managed environments, and security group and role assignments; validate DLP impact on existing resources. - Implement ALM processes with Power Platform Pipelines or Azure DevOps, including approval gates and end-to-end test deployments. - Deploy and report from the CoE Starter Kit and Copilot Studio Starter Kit. - Apply Microsoft 365 and Azure governance fundamentals where they touch AI: external sharing, retention, Azure Policy, and RBAC. Client Engagement & Communication - Act as a trusted advisor to client administrators, platform owners, and security teams; explain governance trade-offs clearly. - Co-lead governance workshops, discovery sessions, and knowledge transfer; deliver instructor-led training on Copilot Studio governance when needed. - Contribute to deliverables: governance frameworks, intake and lifecycle playbooks, runbooks, validation summaries, and decision logs. Additional Knowledge & Skills - Microsoft Fabric and Dataverse-to-Fabric integration patterns. - Azure AI services: Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, and content safety. - Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001. - ServiceNow or ITSM-based intake and approval workflows. - Certifications such as SC-401, SC-900, PL-900, AB-100, or MS-102, or equivalent experience. - Consulting or professional services experience. 10x Engineer SFR3 is a boutique real estate investment fund managing $2B+ of affordable single-family homes. The Fund renovates distressed homes, using software-driven operations to run many “tertiary” markets concurrently. Today we own 10,500+ homes in 20 states. You SFR3 operates like a collection of high-growth startups. You won't just be an engineer; you'll be the engineering lead for a specific business unit—be it Leasing, Utilities, or Field Ops—partnering directly with the business owner to solve the most critical challenges in the world's largest asset class. You love building software that directly enables your team to crack critical business challenges. You’ve shipped production applications and can strike the right balance between shipping fast for immediate impact and long-term vision. You enjoy working remotely along with the independence and responsibility that comes with that. Real estate is the world’s largest asset class, but experience in the domain is not required. What is necessary is motivation to dive in and understand the work people do every day so you can build the right tools that give them leverage. The idea of building & running a $150M/yr business that operates like a startup, growing at 5-7%/yr (not a startup looking for PMF) is exciting to you. What You’ll Do Buying, renovating, and managing a portfolio of thousands of homes worth billions of dollars is a big task. Our team is continuously experimenting to improve efficiency and accelerate operations. To manage single-family rentals at our scale, we write lots of software that runs our operations. Our users are hundreds of employees and vendors located in 40+ markets who renovate homes, repair issues for residents, and prepare our vacant homes for the next move-in. We look for “T-shaped” engineers. You should be comfortable and confident across any stack, but also have deep expertise in one or more areas where you can be the team expert. You will be paired directly with a Business Unit Leader (e.g., Leasing, Utilities, Property Management, etc.) to own the engineering roadmap for that specific domain. You aren't just building for "users"; you are building for your partners in the field who manage everything from resident support and utilities to leasing and move-ins. As the sole engineering lead for your unit, you will work independently to identify friction in business workflows and deliver high-impact software solutions. In this role, you will: - Leverage cutting-edge AI to accelerate development. You’ll experiment with and adopt modern AI tools—like large language models, code-generation platforms, and automation frameworks—to rapidly prototype features, streamline workflows, and continuously innovate. This culture of experimentation and speed ensures we stay ahead of the curve and deliver high-impact products faster. - Design and develop backend systems that power our field and property management operations. You'll build robust and scalable services that integrate with both our in house developed solution and external SaaS whether it be a reliable ledger or AI driven resource optimization models. You must be willing to dive into the "dirt" of business operations to understand the work people do every day, ensuring the tools you build provide maximum leverage. - Integrate with third-party APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.) to enhance our platforms and ensure seamless communication between different services. - Collaborate on scoping and prioritizing the roadmap. We constantly ship and evaluate new problems and opportunities to improve workflows. You’ll regularly interact with users, ship fast, and help define our long-term tech vision—making trade-offs between effort and impact to focus on the most critical work. - Analyze system efficiency and performance. We’re committed to continuous improvement and optimization. You’ll use data to monitor software performance and identify opportunities that drive business results and enhance system reliability. Your Stats You'll be working across multiple backend projects. You might be a great fit if these attributes describe you: - Business Unit "CTO": You have a proven ability to act as the technical lead of a business unit, making pragmatic trade-offs between scrappy speed and long-term durability. - Experience building backend systems that drive real-world processes and results. - Strong expertise in at least one modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, Ruby, etc.) - Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming. - Deep knowledge of AWS and cloud-based services. - Understanding the benefits and tradeoffs of different databases and their setups including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and DynamoDB.. - Business/Product Oriented - Proven ability to tie engineering work to business outcomes and to make pragmatic tradeoffs between scrappy speed and long-term durability. - - Workflow Intuition: You possess a strong "product sense" and can translate messy, real-world operational challenges into clean, scalable backend architecture. - KPI Accountability: You are motivated by moving business needles—such as reducing cycle times or unlocking growth—rather than just shipping code. - AI-first sensibilities. - Entrepreneurial experience preferred. Working timezone overlaps at least 5 working hours with US Pacific and you love cranking late into the evening in an “always on” environment. Comfortable in startup/scale-up environments where priorities shift quickly and ambiguity is the norm. Thrives in shipping fast and iterating based on user and business feedback.

data.title: Senior Database Engineer
data.description:
About Us: Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new. Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust. For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in. About the Role Spreedly is hiring a Senior Database Engineer to become the go-to database expert on our Reliability team. You'll improve the performance and reliability of our existing distributed database environment and help engineering teams make database changes safely. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and "senior" here means more than years of experience: you'll be the person the rest of engineering looks to on anything at the database layer. The opportunity is to shape how we manage and improve our databases, not to lead a migration. We already run CockroachDB, with infrastructure operated through Cockroach Labs' managed service. That means your focus is the part that's ours to own: workload, schema, queries, settings, capacity, and the practices around change. Our Reliability team works across application engineering, infrastructure, and platform to improve monitoring, prevent incidents, and recover quickly when incidents happen. It isn't a textbook SRE team. It's a small, highly autonomous group focused on continuous improvement, with real room to see a problem, propose a fix, and carry it through within the team's priorities. Database availability and performance matter a great deal in a payments environment, and the improvements you make here show up directly in the reliability our customers depend on. Responsibilities: Responsibilities Improve database performance - Investigate our current database setup to find performance bottlenecks and reliability risks, using instrumentation, code review, and staging tests where appropriate. - Find and improve slow-running queries, identify missing or inefficient indexes, and evaluate database settings against what the application actually needs. - Diagnose distributed-database issues such as transaction contention and retries, hot ranges, and inefficient access patterns, and partner with application engineers to fix them at the source. - Establish performance baselines so meaningful changes in workload behavior are visible early. Be the database subject-matter expert - Help engineering teams understand the risks and trade-offs of significant changes before they reach production, including schema migrations, new access patterns, and configuration changes. - Participate in design reviews for systems that place significant demands on the database, and give clear guidance on schema design, primary key selection, indexing, and transaction boundaries. - Contribute database expertise to incident response and root-cause analysis, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes. Own database practices - Develop safer migration procedures, documentation, and guidance so application teams can evolve data models without needing you involved in every step. - Take ongoing ownership of operational practices, including planning version upgrades, validating backup and recovery against our availability objectives, and keeping cluster settings and sizing right for our workload. - Improve database observability so the signals that matter (latency, retries, contention, range health, capacity) are visible and actionable alongside our broader production monitoring. - Work with Cockroach Labs as a knowledgeable counterpart on our managed environment, and help us right-size our database footprint as we grow. Partner across engineering - Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application engineers to improve database performance and availability. - Mentor engineers on database troubleshooting, performance, and distributed-database concepts. Requirements: - 5+ years of experience in a role where operating and optimizing production databases was your primary job, not a side responsibility of application development. - Deep, hands-on experience managing distributed databases, including their performance and high-availability behavior. - Hands-on experience managing relational databases supporting business-critical production systems. - A track record of diagnosing database inefficiencies and delivering measurable improvements to queries, indexing, schema, or configuration. - Strong SQL skills and fluency with execution plans, transaction management, and the trade-offs of distributed SQL (replication, consistency, consensus, distributed transactions). - The ability to assess the risk of a database change and explain technical trade-offs clearly to other engineers. - An independent approach to investigating unfamiliar systems, identifying priorities, and carrying improvements through to completion. - A considerate, collaborative working style with teams whose work depends on yours, and whose expertise you depend on. Additional Skills We Value: - Production experience administering CockroachDB at meaningful transaction volumes, including diagnosing contention, transaction retries, and hot ranges. - PostgreSQL administration experience. - Experience operating a managed database service and working effectively with the vendor's support and engineering teams. - Experience with zero- or minimal-downtime schema migrations on large, high-traffic tables. - Experience supporting payments, financial technology, or similarly availability-sensitive platforms. - Experience with database capacity planning and cluster sizing, including multi-region topologies. - Experience building operational tooling or checks in Python, Go, or similar languages. - Familiarity with how ORMs (for example, Rails ActiveRecord) shape database access patterns. - Cloud experience on AWS or Azure; database-focused cloud certifications are a plus. - Neither CockroachDB nor PostgreSQL experience is a prerequisite if you bring the depth of distributed database management experience this role needs. We Offer Our US-Based Employees: - Competitive salary + Equity - Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid option - Company-paid Life and Disability insurance - Optional vision and supplemental insurance options, and various Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) - Open Paid Time Off policy + 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents - Matching 401(k) plan (5% up to $5,000 yearly) - $1,000 annual professional development stipend - Monthly home working/digital lifestyle stipend, new MacBook, and one-time accessory reimbursement - Access to company-paid professional coaching service - Visits to HQ in Durham, North Carolina for remote employees Compensation Additional Information Spreedly Product Offering: Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include: Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection. Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale. Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates. Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform. Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation. More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26 -- What It's Like to Work Here: We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity. -- We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here. -- Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training. Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check. At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country. We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit. -- #LI-AE1

data.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer — Developer Platform (Remote LATAM)
data.description:
Company: Playbypoint Team: Core Platform Location:LATAM remote. Open to other timezones with overlap to UTC-3 / UTC-5. Employment: Full-time Reports to: Engineering Manager, Core Platform About Playbypoint We're a rapidly expanding startup at the forefront of the racquet sports industry. At Playbypoint, we specialize in providing innovative enterprise software solutions that empower clubs, players, and coaches to streamline their operations and enhance their game. We're backed by top investors, trusted by leading clubs, and scaling fast – and we're looking for passionate individuals to join us in revolutionizing the racquet sports world with cutting-edge software. The Role We're building the platform that lets the world build on top of Playbypoint — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to be part of it. This goes beyond a traditional external API: you'll design and deliver the full stack of surfaces that enable developers, partners, and AI agents to integrate with us — REST APIs, MCP servers, skills, webhooks, and the developer experience layer that ties it all together. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at the intersection of platform engineering and the emerging ecosystem of AI-powered builders. Our stack: Ruby on Rails (backend), React + TypeScript (frontend), GraphQL and REST APIs, MySQL / Redis / Sidekiq, cloud-native infrastructure on AWS. What You'll Do - Design and build Playbypoint's external API — versioned, stable, and built to scale with a growing ecosystem of integrators and partners. - Develop and maintain MCP servers and skills that expose Playbypoint capabilities to AI agents and developer tools. - Own the developer experience end to end: API documentation, developer portal, onboarding flows, SDKs, and sandbox environments. - Define API governance practices: versioning strategy, deprecation policies, backward compatibility, and breaking change management. - Build the infrastructure that makes our external surfaces observable and reliable — rate limiting, auth, throttling, usage analytics. - Partner with product and internal engineering teams to expose platform capabilities through well-designed, consistent integration contracts. - Track and shape how the ecosystem of builders — human and AI — integrates with Playbypoint. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant focus on API design, platform development, or developer tooling. - Are comfortable across the full stack — backend API design and frontend developer portal/documentation surfaces. - Have designed and shipped public or partner-facing APIs at scale — versioning, auth models, rate limiting, and the full lifecycle of an external API are familiar territory. - Have hands-on experience building for AI-era integration surfaces — MCP servers, agent skills, LLM tool definitions, or similar patterns. - Care deeply about developer experience: you've built or contributed to developer portals, SDKs, or documentation systems that builders actually love. - Understand the difference between an internal API and an external one — backward compatibility, contract stability, and the cost of breaking changes are not abstract concepts. - Are comfortable working across teams to define integration contracts that balance internal velocity with external stability. - Communicate clearly and default to async. Strong written and spoken English is a must — we work closely with US-based stakeholders and partners, and our developer-facing surfaces are products in themselves. Engineering in the AI Era We expect every engineer at Playbypoint to work with AI as a core part of their craft — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier across the entire SDLC. That means: - Actively using AI tools throughout the development lifecycle — design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, and incident analysis. - Having built AI-powered tooling or agents — whether internal automation, LLM-integrated features, or workflow improvements that shipped to production. - Knowing when AI adds real value and when it doesn't — judgment matters more than enthusiasm. We don't expect everyone to be an AI researcher. We do expect you to be fluent in the tools and patterns of the moment, and curious about what's next. Bonus - Experience building API gateways, developer portals, or API management platforms. - Deep familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent skill frameworks, or AI-native integration patterns. - Background in vertical SaaS, marketplaces, or fintech — where API reliability directly impacts partner revenue. - Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, webhook infrastructure, or event-driven integration patterns. - Experience with Ruby on Rails at scale.

data.title: Power Platform & Workload Governance Engineer
data.description:
Job Type: FTE Level: Mid to Senior Department: AI Transformation Group Location: Remote (US or Canada) Rate: $115,000 to $145,000 USD (rates vary in Canada) Position Overview Cyclotron's AI Transformation Group is hiring a Power Platform & Workload Governance Consultant to build the governed foundation that enterprise AI runs on. This is a hands-on, client-facing delivery role where Power Platform governance is the headline: environment strategy and landing zones, DLP and connector policy, managed environments, CoE Starter Kit, and ALM. Your second strength is platform and workload governance across Microsoft 365 and Azure: collaboration policy, Azure Policy, landing zones, and application governance. You will also carry enough data, AI, and agent governance knowledge to configure Copilot Studio guardrails and work shoulder to shoulder with our AI and data specialists. The right person has lived inside the Power Platform Admin Center long enough to have informed opinions about it and can turn a governance design into a working, tested configuration. Responsibilities Power Platform Governance - Configure environment strategy and landing zones: tiered and functional environments, environment groups, Development to Stage/UAT to Production models, naming, ownership, maker and admin access, and provisioning standards. - Design and configure classic and advanced DLP policies and connector classification; disable restricted connectors by default and run impact analysis so nothing breaks unintentionally at design time or run time. - Implement ALM: solution packaging, versioning, environment variables, Power Platform Pipelines and Azure DevOps approval flows, and rollback procedures, validated through end-to-end test deployments. - Deploy, customize, and operationalize the CoE Starter Kit and Copilot Studio Starter Kit; assess environment structure, usage, maker activity, connector risk, licensing blockers, and admin processes. - Define and apply Entra ID security group naming standards and security role models across environments, and validate assignments. - Run environment strategy, DLP, ALM, licensing and capacity, and monitoring workshops with client platform teams. Platform & Workload Governance - Implement Microsoft 365 collaboration governance: Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange policy, external sharing, lifecycle, and retention. - Apply Azure governance: landing zones, Azure Policy enforcement, RBAC, tagging, and cost controls for workloads that extend the Power Platform. - Govern the pro-code edge of the platform: custom connectors, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, and secrets handling. Data, AI & Agent Governance - Configure Copilot Studio governance controls: maker access and publishing models, Copilot Studio-specific DLP, credit consumption caps, and production promotion checkpoints. - Support agent intake and lifecycle processes, including ServiceNow or ITSM-based intake, metadata, ownership, and lifecycle states. - Govern Dataverse security and data ownership, and coordinate with Purview and data governance specialists on labeling and DLP. Client Engagement & Communication - Work directly with client Power Platform administrators and platform owners; explain what each setting does and why it matters. - Deliver knowledge transfer and operational handoff so client teams can run what we build. - Contribute to deliverables: environment and governance models, ALM and deployment runbooks, validation summaries, and policy templates. Qualifications - 4+ years of enterprise Microsoft platform experience, with 3+ years hands-on in Power Platform administration, governance, or architecture across multiple environments and business units. - Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and the Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC). You can navigate PPAC quickly and know what each setting does. - Proven experience with environment strategy, DLP design and enforcement, managed environments, and solution ownership and access control models. - Hands-on ALM with Power Platform Pipelines or Azure DevOps, including approval gates and multi-stage promotion. - Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Azure governance fundamentals (Azure Policy, RBAC, landing zones). - Working knowledge of Copilot Studio and how agents are built, published, and secured. - Solid understanding of Entra ID, least privilege, conditional access, and auditability. - Clear, confident client communication and strong emotional intelligence; you explain technical choices plainly and build trust with client admins. - Able to work remotely within the United States or Canada with reliable overlap for Eastern and Central business hours. Governance-fluent bar: we are looking for someone visibly engaged with how the Microsoft AI, data, and automation platforms are governed at enterprise scale. You don't need to check every box below, but the majority should feel like a clear “yes,” and you should be ready to walk us through the relevant ones in a portfolio review: - You have deployed and operationalized the CoE Starter Kit at a real client, not just installed it. - You have designed a DLP policy that did not break every flow, and can explain how you ran the impact analysis. - You have built a Development to Stage/UAT to Production pipeline with approval gates that client teams still use. - You have informed opinions on managed environments versus default, and where the current platform guardrails fall short. Additional Knowledge & Skills - Pro-code depth: Azure Functions, Logic Apps, custom connectors, API Management, and PowerShell or the Power Platform CLI for admin automation. - Microsoft Purview basics: sensitivity labels, DLP, and retention. - Microsoft Fabric and Dataverse-to-Fabric integration patterns. - ServiceNow or ITSM integration for environment and agent requests. - Certifications such as PL-400, PL-600, PL-900, MS-102, or AZ-104, or equivalent experience. - Consulting or professional services experience. About the Company Cyclotron is a Microsoft Solutions Partner focused on the modern workplace, data, and AI. We are dedicated to empowering clients to streamline operations and achieve their business goals. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive environment, encouraging continuous learning and professional growth for its employees. Cyclotron’s mission is to deliver reliable, forward-thinking technology solutions that drive success for clients across various industries. What We Can Offer Cyclotron offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth in a fully remote work environment. We provide competitive health, dental, and vision insurance, and we cover 100% of employee medical premiums. Our team members benefit from generous and flexible paid time off (PTO), retirement plan options, and ongoing training opportunities. Additionally, Cyclotron promotes work-life balance with flexible work arrangements and robust wellness programs, creating a rewarding and supportive workplace for all. Cyclotron relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees to join our team, regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. Cyclotron is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Cyclotron values diversity, equity and inclusion, and aims to practice DE&I in all that we do.

data.title: Principal Solutions Consultant
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA)

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking a Principal Solutions Consultant to join our talented, customer-focused team! You will be a key strategic leader and the "technical face" of PagerDuty across the US region. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. You won’t just be selling a platform; you will be partnering with CTOs, CIOs, and VPs of Engineering at the US’s most influential enterprises to redefine how they manage digital operations, resilience, and automation.

You will act as a bridge between our customers’ long-term strategic needs and PagerDuty’s product roadmap. You will spend your time evangelizing the PagerDuty Operations Cloud, mentoring our high-performing technical sales teams, and acting as a trusted advisor to the C-suite on topics ranging from AIOps and SRE maturity to digital transformation and cloud migration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a peer and advisor to customer CTOs and CIOs, helping them navigate complex digital transformations and operationalizing the PagerDuty Operations Cloud within their organizations.
  • Represent PagerDuty as a thought leader at major industry events and through digital content, white-papers, and local media.
  • Partner closely with our Global Product and Engineering leadership in San Francisco to ensure the unique requirements of the US markets are represented in our long-term roadmap.
  • Provide architectural oversight and executive presence for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise opportunities across the US.
  • Foster a local community of DevOps and SRE leaders, sharing best practices on operational excellence, incident response, and the ethical application of AI in operations.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on the competitive landscape, identifying market shifts and technical trends that PagerDuty can capitalize on.

Who You Are

  • You have a deep-seated passion for the future of digital operations. You can articulate not just where the industry is today, but where it will be in 3–5 years.
  • You are equally comfortable white-boarding a complex micro services architecture with a Lead Architect as you are presenting a business value case to a Board of Directors.
  • You have a strong technical foundation. You understand the "pains" of the modern developer because you’ve lived them.
  • You don’t just want to close deals; you want to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes and see PagerDuty as a mission-critical partner.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in technical leadership, solutions architecture, or product management within the SaaS, DevOps, or Cloud infrastructure space.
  • Proven track record of engaging with and influencing C-level executives at Fortune 500 or equivalent global enterprises, navigating complex organizations.
  • Proven ability to support and influence sales cycles with a solid grasp of sales processes and customer buying journeys
  • Deep domain expertise in at least three of the following: Incident Management, SRE (Site Reliability Engineering), AIOps, Cloud Native Architectures, ITSM/ITIL, or Cybersecurity Incident Response.
  • Exceptional public speaking and written communication skills.
  • Ability to travel across the US and occasionally overseas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active involvement in the tech community (mentorship, open-source contribution, or advisory/board positions).
  • Experience navigating the regulatory landscape for US financial services or government sectors (e.g., FedRAMP) as it relates to cloud resiliency.

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

About the Job:

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead LaunchDarkly’s Cloud Engineering team, the team responsible for the foundational infrastructure our products and engineering teams depend on.

Cloud Engineering owns LaunchDarkly’s AWS accounts and networking, multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, Terraform and GitOps workflows, CockroachDB operations, disaster-recovery capabilities, and FedRAMP infrastructure posture. The team is small, senior, and recently rebuilt. This is a frontline leadership role for a manager who treats operational health as a top priority, leads calmly through incidents, and creates leverage through software, automation, and reliable paved paths.

In your first year, you’ll lead a marquee infrastructure insourcing program from planning through completion. The program’s cost savings will help fund additional team growth, giving you the opportunity to deliver meaningful business impact while strengthening the infrastructure behind LaunchDarkly’s next stage of scale.

This role combines people leadership, operational ownership, and technical judgment. You do not need to be the most senior individual contributor in the room, but you should be comfortable partnering with experienced engineers, guiding tradeoffs, and creating an environment where the team can do its best work.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a senior Cloud Engineering team, providing clear expectations, coaching, feedback, performance management, and career-development support.
  • Own the operational health of LaunchDarkly’s cloud infrastructure, including incident response, on-call health, service-level objectives, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Launch and deliver a multi-quarter infrastructure insourcing program, including sequencing work, managing dependencies, communicating milestones, and ensuring a successful transition.
  • Guide technical priorities and tradeoffs across AWS infrastructure, networking, multi-region Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, datastore operations, and compliance-related infrastructure.
  • Build leverage through software, automation, and paved paths that help product engineering teams use infrastructure safely and independently.
  • Support migrations by providing guidance, patterns, and enablement while maintaining clear ownership boundaries with partner teams.
  • Establish team norms for effective AI-assisted engineering and identify opportunities to reduce operational toil through AI and automation.
  • Maintain team health and continuity through change, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable environment.
  • Partner with Service Frameworks, Core Platform, Revenue Platform, Data Platform, and product engineering teams on shared infrastructure priorities and cross-team dependencies.
  • Communicate roadmaps, operational risks, investment needs, and progress clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Participate in hiring and team planning as the organization grows.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience managing an infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering team at a product company, including people management of an on-call team.
  • Demonstrated ownership of incident response, on-call health, and service-level objective frameworks for critical production systems.
  • Experience leading at least one multi-quarter infrastructure migration or insourcing program from planning through completion.
  • Technical fluency with AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices, with the judgment to guide discussions and tradeoffs with senior engineers.
  • Experience taking over an established team and maintaining engagement, performance, and retention through a leadership transition.
  • A clear point of view on team norms and practices for AI-assisted engineering.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and operational priorities to a range of audiences.
  • A thoughtful, calm, and accountable leadership approach, particularly during incidents and periods of change.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with vendor negotiations or cloud cost management.
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP or other compliance-related infrastructure and operations.
  • Experience operating large-scale datastores or OLAP systems.
  • Experience growing a team through funded expansion.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M2:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $163,000 - $224,070**
  • All Zones Inclusive of a 10% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

Headquarters: Argentina Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

  • Location: Remote-first (Argentina)
  • Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)
  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position.

As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

  • Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.
  • Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.
  • Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.
  • Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.
  • Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.
  • Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About you

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

  • Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
  • Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.
  • Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.
  • Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.
  • Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.
  • Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.
  • Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

  • Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.
  • Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana
  • Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.
  • Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are:

  • Collaborative: You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.
  • Strategic thinker: You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.
